correctness.rationale: For each strictly positive probability vector the transfer eigenvalues are strictly inside the unit disk. All block tensor embeddings are injective because their word products contain nonzero multiples of all four Pauli basis matrices. The exact two-block density operator is a local full-column-rank image of a tensor of spectator identities with the output-first Choi operator of the L-fold channel. Its local left inverse recovers this operator, preserving and reflecting both separability and PPT. The qubit Choi PPT criterion and the established unital-qubit channel octahedron give the sharp inequality including equality; strict violation is NPT. The isotropic ceiling follows from \(3s^L\leq1\) and local product convergence follows from tensor coefficients. The included verification script passed 57 direct finite-dimensional tests; they are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Gives an exact parameterized finite-length invariant for a natural three-parameter family of primitive lattice spin-chain states, uniform over arbitrary finite sizes of both disjoint intervals. It proves NPT before the sharp separability threshold rather than supplying only a qualitative existence bound, and exhibits a physically motivated near-product regime with length divergence asymptotic to log(3)/(1-s). The exact conditional family classification is a useful sharp benchmark for more general quantitative gapped-state entanglement-death results, despite using known mathematical ingredients.
